user_q_residual_classification.interpretation: User-q residuals are dominated by multi-hop disjunctive questions of the form "which, X or Y?" where the answer (X or Y) must appear in the question by construction. This leakage is STRUCTURAL to the dataset, present in ALL conditions (oracle_full, oracle_redacted_full, no_api), therefore symmetric and does NOT affect between-condition deltas that section 3.5 decomposition relies on. Non-disjunctive residuals (2/106 substring hits: pid=1 gold "American"->"american folklore"; pid=55 gold "rock"->"rock band") are coincidental common-word matches.

gap_753_vs_1663_explanation: eval_sft_with_api.py:397 stores generated_text[:2000]. Worker A counted json.dumps(details[i]).count("[REDACTED]") = 753 across full details dict (generated_text[:2000] + predicted_answer + predicted_parts, where the model echoed some [REDACTED] tokens into its own answer). Phase 0 dry-run counts 1663 by redacting full oracle blocks. Gap is 100% a JSON-serialization artifact of the 2000-char cap on generated_text; generate_with_retrieval tokenizes full current_text without max_length/truncation so the model DOES see all 1663 [REDACTED] tokens in context.
